## Evidence
Attach a screenshot or **Help → Export diagnostics** archive after reviewing it for private names and paths. Include a Signal Labs recording only when it is relevant and deliberately reviewed.

Do not post personal profiles, credentials, unrelated recordings, or your entire settings folder. For a suspected security problem, use GitHub's private vulnerability-reporting flow instead of posting exploit details publicly.
